item.title: Futanari Kanojo Kyousei Seikatsu ~Atashi no Milk, Anata ni Shiboritotte Hoshii!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FREAK STRIKE
  • 発売日: 2018-05-25
  • スコア: 6.38/10 (31 人評価)
  • 日本語名: フタナリ彼女矯正生活 ～あたしのミルク、アナタに絞りとって欲しいっ～
  • 英語名: Futanari Kanojo Kyousei Seikatsu Atashi no Milk, Anata ni Shiboritotte Hoshii!

あらすじ

Five years have passed after the events of Doukyuusei Kaizou Namaiki Musume wa Jikkendai ni Shiteshimae! when the protagonist successfully ostracized a girl he disliked who kept picking fights with him by “transforming her into a futanari” with his new drug and effectively silencing her socially.
